verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for an error-monitoring service, so the axis applies. The evidence only describes Rollbar as a hosted SaaS: an API at api.rollbar.com, pricing tiers, and GitHub/Google sign-up. Local pieces such as rollbar-agent file forwarding, the SDK offline payload store and the stdio MCP server are adjacent client-side components, not a self-hosted deployment of the core product.
